decks.notes: The main concept of this Aggro - Red Deck Wins Modern deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using a combination of efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Boros Charm, along with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Skullcrack. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to red mana sources to efficiently cast spells and close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to control the opponent's hand. The deck has efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to deal with threats on the board. Additionally, it has powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six to generate value and control the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Pyrite Spellbomb and Nihil Spellbomb provide additional utility and flexibility in various situations.

The main idea behind this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while quickly applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck also utilizes cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death to protect its creatures and keep them on the field, allowing for continuous aggression. Additionally, the deck includes some removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with any threats from the opponent, making it a versatile and powerful aggressive deck in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells and efficient creatures to maintain pressure on the opponent. By combining burn spells like Lightning Bolt, countermagic, and aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The inclusion of card draw spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble helps maintain card advantage while controlling the board. Murktide Regent and Subtlety provide additional threats and disruption to the opponent's game plan. The mana base is carefully optimized to support the deck's aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and cascade effects, allowing for explosive and unpredictable turns. Utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone, the deck aims to create a fast clock and maintain board control. With a mix of counterspells like Mystical Dispute and removal options like Subtlety and Force of Negation, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily advancing its own.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using spells like Desperate Ritual and Manamorphose to cast Goblin Charbelcher, which deals lethal damage to the opponent. Recross the Paths helps to find necessary pieces quickly. Other cards like Pyromancer Ascension and Spikefield Hazard provide additional utility and removal options. The deck aims to win quickly through a powerful combo without relying on traditional lands for mana production. Various card draw and recursion options help to maintain consistency and resilience in the face of disruption.

The deck focuses on using control elements to manipulate the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It utilizes a combination of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Solitude, along with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Karn, the Great Creator. The One Ring and Leyline Binding help to lock down key threats, while cards like Preordain and Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and flexibility. The deck aims to control the game and eventually win with powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Delighted Halfling. The manabase is optimized for consistency and flexibility.

This deck focuses on using Underworld Breach and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to continuously loop spells and artifacts from the graveyard to generate value and eventually win through a combo involving Thassa's Oracle. It also utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Urza's Saga for additional card advantage and mana ramp. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating incremental advantage through card draw and mana acceleration.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of hand disruption and creature removal. It aims to quickly generate early pressure on the opponent using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. The deck also utilizes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its key creatures and maintain board presence. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures and disruptive spells.

The focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Colossus Hammer equipped onto a creature, preferably Puresteel Paladin, and swing for lethal damage. The deck utilizes cards like Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for the equipment, Urza's Saga to search for key pieces, and Sigarda's Aid to equip at instant speed. The deck also includes protection spells like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful combo before they have a chance to react.

The main idea of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible using efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Searing Blaze and Lightning Bolt while maintaining pressure with cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack. The deck is focused on burning the opponent out while also keeping the pressure up with quick and efficient creatures, making it a strong choice for aggressive players looking to win fast.

The main concept of this deck is to deal consistent and heavy damage to the opponent quickly using a mix of direct burn spells and aggressive creatures. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and maintain that pressure throughout, using efficient spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Rift Bolt, along with fast creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck also includes cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack to prevent the opponent from gaining life or stabilizing, while also utilizing lands like Sunbaked Canyon and Roiling Vortex to provide additional damage and reach.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Amulet of Vigor combo to generate tons of mana and play Primeval Titan to search for powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Boros Garrison. The deck aims to ramp up quickly, find its combo pieces, and overwhelm the opponent with giant creatures and land-based triggers. Key cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and Urza's Saga help accelerate the deck's strategy, while cards like Golgari Rot Farm and Simic Growth Chamber provide additional land ramp potential.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and Narset's ability to limit the opponent's draws. The key strategy revolves around using The One Ring to continuously exile cards from the opponent's graveyard and potentially lock them out of playing their spells. Teferi, Time Raveler also provides additional control elements by bouncing problematic permanents and slowing down the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its win conditions through efficient removal and card advantage.

The main concept of this Dimir control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. By controlling the board with cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Counterspell, while also utilizing card advantage through Snapcaster Mage and card selection with Consider, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and win the game with powerful threats such as Murktide Regent. The deck's mana base is also optimized to ensure smooth color fixing and consistent access to all spells.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful creatures like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Counterspell. It aims to apply early pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Dismember to deal with threats that may arise. It utilizes a combination of aggressive creatures and control elements to maintain tempo and outmaneuver the opponent, ultimately securing victory through efficient and disruptive plays.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies with a combination of tempo control and card advantage. Utilizing fast and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with interaction spells such as Lightning Bolt and Counterspell, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while putting pressure on them. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration provides card selection and helps maintain consistency. Murktide Regent and Subtlety offer additional threats and versatility. Overall, the deck seeks to maintain a proactive game plan and efficient use of resources to secure victory.
